text: This report recommends that the name "Trinity Park Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located north of Queen Street West, extending easterly from Crawford Street. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Trinity Park Lane" for an existing public lane located north of Queen Street West, extending easterly from Crawford Street.
